big_picture.title: Stock Market Shows Resilience Ahead Of Thanksgiving Holiday; Anthropic Rises, Nvidia Sinks
big_picture.excerpt: After a poor start, the Dow ends in the black Wednesday while the Nasdaq and S&P 500 trim losses.
paragraphs: The stock market improved dramatically by the end of Wednesday's session after falling on a hotter-than-anticipated inflation reading, while signs of a booming economy firmed up bets for a December rate hike. Major indexes trimmed losses and finished near session highs ahead of the Thanksgiving Day holiday, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average completing a stunning turnaround.

While tech stocks remain broadly under pressure, high-profile artificial intelligence name Nvidia (NVDA) finished sharply off its intraday low, and IPO stock Anthropic (ANT) swung higher. The Dow Jones Industrial Average climbed back into the black, gaining 0.3% after erasing a loss of more than 1,100 points. The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq sliced their declines down to 0.3% and 0.6%, respectively.
